profile.name: Suprince Shakya
profile.bio:
I'm a full-stack developer in Lalitpur, Nepal. I work at Swivt Technology, where I build web products with Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Before that I worked at Gurzu on backend services and Shopify apps.

Most of my time goes into the parts users don't see: data modeling, API design, auth, deployments, and keeping the interface fast. I also build mobile apps with React Native.
profile.currently: Building full-stack features at Swivt Technology. Lately that means Next.js, Node.js, MongoDB, and a lot of time in the browser profiler.

about.headline: I like software that is small, fast, and easy to change.
paragraphs: I started out building Node.js services for IoT devices at Real Time Solutions. Since then I've worked on backend services, Shopify apps, dashboards, and product teams at Gurzu and Swivt. I've been doing this long enough to know that most of the job is reading code, asking better questions, and keeping things simple.

I'm most useful on teams that need someone to move between the database, the API, and the interface without losing the thread. I care about clear naming, small diffs, and leaving code easier to work with than I found it.
